column1: # Recorded per-suite wall time in seconds (ceil, min 1), read by TestShards.py to balance CI test shards.
# Measured, not modelled: gtest XML <testsuites time> of CI run #900 (36426811427) for windows-debug and
# windows-release; the RunTests.sh per-suite line of ASan job 108846696982 (run #892) for asan. All three
# were taken under in-job concurrency (4 / 4 / 3 suites at once), which is also how shards run them.
# "-" = not measured on that platform; a suite missing from this table gets the median of its column.
# A stale row costs balance, never correctness: TestShards.py plans over the expected-suite list, not this table.
# Refresh: python3 scripts/CI/TestShards.py timings <reports-dir> <column>  (prints rows to paste).
